==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=SendGrid&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Extensions/SendGridTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=SendGrid&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using SendGrid.Helpers.Mail;

// Verify.SendGrid: Snapshots SendGrid types: SendGridMessage, EmailAddress, Attachment and Personalization.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.SendGrid
// Note: It registers serializer converters only, with no file extension converter, so it cannot
// collide with a format based extension.
// Note: VerifySendGrid exposes only Initialize(): there are no settings methods or scrubbers.
// Note: Covered types are SendGridMessage, EmailAddress, Attachment and Personalization, including
// the reply-to variants.
// Note: The package's description and tags are copied from Verify.MailMessage and its
// RootNamespace says Verify.ZeroLog; the package itself is right.
public class SendGridTests
{
    // The message is verified, not the delivery: no account, api key or network access is
    // needed, and the snapshot shows what would have been sent.
    // Addresses render as Name <address>, and empty members are left out.
    [Fact]
    public Task Message()
    {
        var mail = new SendGridMessage
        {
            From = new("test@example.com", "DX Team"),
            Subject = "Sending with Twilio SendGrid is Fun",
            PlainTextContent = "and easy to do anywhere, even with C#",
            HtmlContent = "<strong>and easy to do anywhere, even with C#</strong>"
        };
        mail.AddTo(new EmailAddress("test@example.com", "Test User"));
        return Verify(mail);
    }

    // SendGrid holds attachment content as base64, which is unreadable in a diff. The converter
    // decodes it, so the snapshot shows the text and a changed attachment is visible.
    [Fact]
    public Task EmailAttachment()
    {
        var contentBytes = "The content"u8.ToArray();
        var attachment = new Attachment
        {
            Filename = "name.txt",
            Content = Convert.ToBase64String(contentBytes),
            Type = "text/html",
            Disposition = "attachment"
        };
        return Verify(attachment);
    }

    // Recipients live in a Personalization list rather than on the message, and the converter
    // flattens it, so the reply-to and both recipients read as plain lines.
    [Fact]
    public Task Personalizations()
    {
        var mail = new SendGridMessage
        {
            From = new("test@example.com", "DX Team"),
            Subject = "The subject",
            ReplyTo = new("reply@example.com", "Reply To")
        };
        mail.AddTo(new EmailAddress("first@example.com", "First"));
        mail.AddTo(new EmailAddress("second@example.com", "Second"));
        return Verify(mail);
    }
}
